transport.serviceHost: Phone or Mac controller (RFCOMM server); speaker initiates the connection
transport.channelPolicy: Publish a local RFCOMM service and accept the speaker connection on the assigned local channel. Android advertised channel 6 in capture record 450.
transport.macOSPublicAPITest: Verified direct incoming RFCOMM, full bootstrap, all nine initial reads and 47 write/readback operations. See XB30-Mac-Hardware-Validation.log.
transport.macOSRecovery: This Mac can retain stale SDP records after process exit despite remove returning success. Reuse the record within a process; the explicit Restore Bluetooth button cycles the radio to clear stale records, temporarily disconnecting other accessories.

tandem.frame: 3E + escaped(dataType, sequence, uint32be(payload length), payload, sum8) + 3C
tandem.sequence: Start DATA at 0. After the ACK for a DATA, use the ACK sequence for the next DATA. ACK received DATA with 1 - incomingSequence.

Andrea subsequently confirmed 50/50 at full charge both on AC and battery. The charge threshold remains unknown. Do not misreport 46 as 36 percent or hardcode it as the universal maximum.
